8e85baa55797e21b.description: Job description Join our Team About this opportunity: At Ericsson, the Change Manager plays a key role in Managed Services delivery, operating in line with the Ericsson Operations Engine. The role governs and coordinates changes to customer networks, infrastructure, and services, ensuring compliance with established processes while minimizing customer impact. Responsibilities include risk assessment, impact analysis, scheduling, approvals, and execution governance. Coordinate planned activities with customers, internal delivery teams, Field Operations, and third-party vendors. Monitor change execution against approved schedules, procedures, and operational requirements. Review outcomes, validate service stability, and ensure accurate documentation and formal closure of CRs. Ensure CMDB updates following approved changes, where applicable. Monitor change management KPIs, including success rates, first-time-right execution, emergency changes, and change-related incidents. Drive continuous improvement to reduce change failures, minimize customer impact, and strengthen operational governance. Maintain standard operating procedures, operational documentation, and knowledge-sharing practices. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure service continuity and alignment with customer requirements. You will bring: BSc in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent. 5+ years of experience in telecommunications or a related operational environment. Knowledge of GSM, WCDMA, LTE, 5G, IP, Core Network, and telecom network architectures. Understanding of change management processes, CRs, CABs, and operational governance. Knowledge of change planning, risk assessment, impact analysis, implementation validation, and rollback procedures. Basic knowledge of automation, continuous improvement, and corrective and preventive actions. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, teamwork, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration abilities. Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate multiple activities, and work effectively under pressure. 8e24af50fb51133b.description: The Function Head – Finance & Accounting is responsible for the overall financial management, business analysis, and strategic financial planning . This role ensures the ongoing financial feasibility, regulatory compliance, and secure financial future of the organisation in alignment with its mission, vision, and the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. The incumbent leads the Finance & Accounting team, drives digital transformation of financial processes, and serves as the primary business partner to the CFO and executive leadership across all financial, treasury, tax, and reporting matters. Treasury & Capital Management ▪ Manage treasury operations including cash flow planning, banking relationship management, and credit facility oversight. ▪ Monitor investment portfolio performance and provide recommendations to the CFO on capital allocation. ▪ Ensure financial discipline, cashflow forecasting accuracy, and cost reporting transparency across all business units. ▪ Provide executive-level reporting on financial performance, risk exposure, and treasury position. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) ▪ Monthly financial statements delivered to CFO by the 10th working day of the following month. ▪ Annual budget submission completed within agreed timeline (100% on time). ▪ Zero material audit qualifications or regulatory penalties in the financial year. ▪ All ZATCA VAT and Zakat filings submitted before statutory deadlines (100% compliance). ▪ Finance function fully staffed and performing against individual KPIs. ▪ At least 2 finance process improvement initiatives implemented per financial year. ▪ Real-time financial dashboards live and maintained for all key business units via Power BI. 7.
